_comment: Screenshots gallery for the /artwork/ page. Items with draft:true are admin-only visible until approved. Items with proposed:true are AppC pitch suggestions that don't have files captured yet — they show description-only cards in the admin draft queue until the file lands. Once the autoplay-capture pipeline ships, captured screenshots auto-append here with draft:true.

screenshots.title: Title screen — hero shot (DEBUG BUILD)
screenshots.description: The Chronicles of Nesis title card with the windmill, hills, and clouds backdrop. Main menu (New Game / Continue / Options / Quit) overlaid. Captured 2026-06-04 from prod /play/. PROBLEM: shows the dev-mode admin debug bar in the top-left — this is the current /play/ build serving the debug variant to everyone. Needs re-capture after Arc ships the non-debug public build per APP_CLAUDE_TIER_GATED_BUILDS.md.
screenshots.blocked_on: Re-capture from /godot/public/ once Arc ships non-debug build
